rule: One stage, one surface, one turn, presentation only.

stages.title: Connect
apply: Add the Sparq MCP server and the consumer agent rules.
Do not point existing styles at the new variables yet.
suggest: Confirm the screenshot matches the app from before the link. If it does not, the stylesheet is doing more than declaring variables.

stages.title: Ground and ink
apply: On the named files, set background and text colors to Sparq variables.
Leave cards, radii, buttons, and copy as they are.

stages.title: Type
apply: Swap font families to the Sparq sans and mono stacks.

stages.title: Seams
apply: On the one named surface, replace a card border with a 1px hairline.
Keep the same elements. Leave sibling screens alone.

stages.title: Accent
apply: On that same surface, restyle filled accent chrome as an accent hairline or text treatment.
The control stays the same control.

stages.title: Focus
apply: Add a visible focus style and a 24px hit area, using padding or min-size, on that surface.
suggest: Rebuilding tab order, roving tabindex, or live regions is behavior. Do not code it in this stage.

stages.title: AI movement
apply: If a status word is already rendered, place a presentational orb beside it and hide the canvas from assistive tech.
suggest: Do not invent a status, bind the orb to new state, or change when work starts and stops.
